s.en: run a command with a time limit
s.es: ejecuta un comando y lo mata si tarda más del tiempo indicado

o.es: Señal con la que se corta (por defecto TERM).
o.en: Specify the signal to be sent on timeout.

o.es: Si sigue vivo tras ese tiempo, lo mata con KILL.
o.en: Also send a KILL signal if command is still running this long after the initial signal.
when not running timeout directly from a shell prompt, allow COMMAND to read from the TTY and get TTY signals; in this mode, children of COMMAND will not be timed out
exit with the same status as COMMAND, even when the command times out
diagnose to standard error any signal sent upon timeout
